_comment: `bridge.js` puts `barrel.js` and `leaf.js` in a second chunk. `main.js` reads `f` of `leaf.js` through the deferred namespace of `d.js`, so the second chunk also exports `init_leaf` to the main chunk, although the main chunk does not call it. The export needs the declaration, so `leaf.js` must keep its wrapper and must not become a member of the group of `barrel.js`. `format` is set, so that the extended variant runs with `minifyInternalExports: false`.
